from pathlib import Path
import ast,hashlib,json,resource,signal,sys,time,traceback
import sympy as s
from sympy.polys.matrices import DomainMatrix
ROOT=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'code'))
from classification_three_hyperplanes_quadric_independent import ambient_matrices
from classification_rank3_mixed_component_review import COLUMNS,ROWS,sparse,vector,jacobi
JOB=ROOT/'research/classification/jobs/rank_one_long_nonconstant_one_ambient.json';job=json.loads(JOB.read_text())
for item in job['exact_inputs_and_hashes']:assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/item['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item['sha256'],item['path']
frozen=json.loads((ROOT/'research/classification/inputs/rank_one_long_nonconstant_one_ambient_caller_20261108.json').read_text());assert hashlib.sha256(frozen['inline_source'].encode()).hexdigest()==frozen['inline_source_sha256']
OUT=ROOT/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_RANK_ONE_LONG_NONCONSTANT_ONE_AMBIENT_20261108.json';assert not OUT.exists();started=time.monotonic();resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(3072*1024**2,)*2)
def timeout(*_):raise TimeoutError('ONE structurallygeneric longnonconstant anchor180s')
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,timeout);signal.alarm(180)
result={'task_id':'E_multiple_hyperplane','all_exact_arithmetic_passed':False,'componenthood_status':'PENDING','failure':None}
def encode(A):return{'shape':list(A.shape),'entries':{str(i)+','+str(j):str(v)for(i,j),v in A.todok().items()}}
def certificate(A):
 dm=DomainMatrix.from_Matrix(A).convert_to(s.QQ);rr,piv=dm.rref();piv=list(piv);rows=list(dm.extract(range(A.rows),piv).transpose().rref()[1]);assert len(rows)==len(piv);free=[j for j in range(A.cols)if j not in piv];K=s.zeros(A.cols,len(free));red=rr.to_Matrix()
 for k,j in enumerate(free):
  K[j,k]=1
  for i,lead in enumerate(piv):K[lead,k]=-red[i,j]
 assert A*K==s.zeros(A.rows,K.cols)and K[free,:]==s.eye(len(free));det=A.extract(rows,piv).det(method='domain-ge');assert det
 return{'rank':len(piv),'nullity':len(free),'minor_rows':rows,'minor_columns':piv,'minor_determinant':str(det),'free_columns':free,'complete_kernel_sparse':encode(K),'all_original_rows_annihilate_kernel':True,'kernel_free_identity':True}
try:
 h,x,y,z,w=xx=s.symbols('h x y z w');r=y-x*x/2;alpha=s.Integer(2);beta=s.Integer(3);gamma=s.Integer(5);g=z;u=alpha*z;v=beta+gamma*z;K=1+2*z+3*w+5*z*z+7*z*w+11*w*w;d=s.diff(u,z)+s.diff(v,w);F=s.expand(u*s.diff(K,z)+v*s.diff(K,w)+(d+1)*K);H=s.expand(g*K)
 assert F==12+46*z+75*w+70*z*z+145*z*w+33*w*w
 aff={(1,2):-F-(1+d)*r,(1,3):u,(1,4):v,(2,3):x*u+r*s.diff(g,w)+s.diff(H,w),(2,4):x*v-r*s.diff(g,z)-s.diff(H,z),(3,4):g};P=s.zeros(5);scale=s.Integer(2)
 for(i,j),f in aff.items():
  homog=s.expand(scale*h*h*f.subs({q:q/h for q in xx[1:]},simultaneous=True));assert s.Poly(homog,*xx).total_degree()==2;P[i,j]=homog;P[j,i]=-homog
 assert all(c.q==1 for i in range(5)for j in range(i+1,5)for c in s.Poly(P[i,j],*xx).coeffs())
 point=json.loads((ROOT/'research/classification/inputs/rank_one_long_nonconstant_one_anchor_20261108.json').read_text());assert point['complete_homogeneous_integer_brackets']=={str((i,j)):str(P[i,j])for i in range(5)for j in range(i+1,5)}
 raw=jacobi(sparse(P,xx),raw=True);assert all(not vals for vals in raw.values());assert jacobi(sparse(P,xx))==s.zeros(350,1)
 div=[s.expand(sum(s.diff(P[i,j],xx[i])for i in range(5)))for j in range(5)];assert div==[0,2*h,2*x,0,0]
 Q=s.expand(h*y-x*x/2+h*h+2*h*z+3*h*w+5*z*z+7*z*w+11*w*w);qm=s.hessian(Q,xx)/2;assert qm.det()!=0
 result.update({'integer_scale_for_same_point':2,'coordinates':list(map(str,xx)),'all350_original_Jacobi_zero':True,'all10_strict_Jacobi_zero':True,'homogeneous_modular_vector':list(map(str,div)),'quadric_Q':str(Q),'quadric_symmetric_matrix_determinant':str(qm.det()),'full150_point':list(map(str,vector(sparse(P,xx)))),'complete_homogeneous_integer_brackets':{str((i,j)):str(P[i,j])for i in range(5)for j in range(i+1,5)},'coefficient_order':[{'pair':list(ij),'exponent':list(e)}for ij,e in COLUMNS],'equation_order':[{'quad':list(q),'exponent':list(e)}for q,e in ROWS]})
 D,V,M,extra=ambient_matrices(P,xx,[P]);assert extra==M.row_join(M[:,-1])and D*M==s.zeros(350,51)
 mats={'D350x150':D,'Euler150x25':V,'Euler_GL_scalar150x51':M};result['complete_sparse_matrices']={k:encode(A)for k,A in mats.items()};result['certificates']={}
 for name,A in mats.items():result['certificates'][name]=certificate(A)
 dr=result['certificates']['D350x150']['rank'];vr=result['certificates']['Euler150x25']['rank'];mr=result['certificates']['Euler_GL_scalar150x51']['rank'];assert vr==24;assert dr<=100,'D>100 contradicts priorwholeZ25; diagnosepureentrance'
 pfs={};Dactual=0
 for i in range(5):
  j,k,l,t=[q for q in range(5)if q!=i];pf=s.expand(P[j,k]*P[l,t]-P[j,l]*P[k,t]+P[j,t]*P[k,l]);pfs[str(i)]=str(pf);Dactual+=(-1)**i*xx[i]*pf
 Dactual=s.expand(Dactual);assert s.expand(Dactual+4*h*h*z*Q)==0
 result.update({'all350_D_times_full51_actual_group_columns_zero':True,'all_five_four_by_four_Pfaffians':pfs,'actual_signed_Euler_Pfaffian':str(Dactual),'actual_projective_orbit_dimension':mr-25,'projective_tangent_dimension':125-dr,'whole_irreducible_source_image_dimension_from_pure_entrance':25,'componenthood_status':'smooth_unique25_full_component_candidate_independent_review_pending'if dr==100 else'exact_unresolved_stop_point_route_no_new_anchor','no_second_point_profile_jet':True,'all_exact_arithmetic_passed':True})
except BaseException:
 result['failure']=traceback.format_exc()
finally:
 signal.alarm(0);result.update({'inline_source':frozen['inline_source'],'inline_source_sha256':frozen['inline_source_sha256'],'input_bindings':job['exact_inputs_and_hashes'],'seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'maximum_RSS_KiB':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss})
 with OUT.open('x')as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
 print(json.dumps({k:result.get(k)for k in ['all_exact_arithmetic_passed','componenthood_status','projective_tangent_dimension','actual_projective_orbit_dimension','seconds','maximum_RSS_KiB','failure']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
if not result['all_exact_arithmetic_passed']:raise RuntimeError(result['failure'])
